If we are to fulfill our plan to bring Fondor to ruin, we must act now.|Hurlo Holowan, droid engineer of the ''Sun Runner'' replica, and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]|<ref name="SWA3:THP">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref>}}
'''Hurlo Holowan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designer and [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] from [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and the daughter of a wealthy merchant house patriarch. She designed the [[Razor Eater]], the fiercest killing machine ever seen on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Mandalorian armor. Very rare, extremely durable. You make a nice-looking couple. Can I assume you're both bounty hunters?''"<br />"''Assume what you want. I'm going to ask you one question. If you lie, I'll know, and you'll be dead.''"<br />"''How do I know you won't kill me even if I tell the truth?''"<br />"''That's your problem. Where's Groodo the Hutt?''"<br />"''Balmorra. Before he dropped me off on Kuat, I overheard him having a HoloNet conversation with his brother on Balmorra, a factory world. That's where Groodo was headed. His name's Rigorra, and he's the Warlord of Balmorra.|Hurlo Holowan persuaded by Zam Wesell, Jango Fett and his [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|Westar-34 blaster]] to tell the truth|<ref name="SWA6:TWOB">''[[Star Wars Adventures 6: The Warlords of Balmorra]]''</ref>}}
Holowan was the creator of the sophisticated [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that piloted [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit ''Sun Runner'']], a replica of the [[Sun Runner|ancient colonial transport]] from the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]]. She also was the engineer and controller of the Hutt's [[Droid Control Army]] that attempted to take over and destroy the [[Fondor Spaceport]] and the planet's major surface facilities.<ref name="SWA3:THP" />

Soon thereafter, Holowan was hunted down by both [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was hired by [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] to take the droid engineer alive, and hunters [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] and his son [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], who were simultaneously hired for the job (but to bring in her head) by [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]. Fett, in the end, achieved the task, by subcontracting the job to fellow hunter [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], and he turned Holowan over to Darth Tyranus alive. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], impressed with the concept of the ''Sun Runner'' scheme hatched by Groodo, Senator [[Rodd]] and Holowan—and with the ingenuity, ambition, talent, and secrecy they demonstrated—wished to recruit them to [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|his cause]].<ref name="SWA4:JFVTRE">''[[Star Wars Adventures 4: Jango Fett vs. the Razor Eaters]]''</ref><ref name="SWA5:TSSS">''[[Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes]]''</ref><ref name="SWA6:TWOB" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Listen, I don't know who hired you to catch me, but ... I have access to money on Kuat. Lots of money. So I was thinking, maybe we could work out a deal? If I help you get into Rigorra's castle— ...You'll never get to Groodo without my help! Rigorra's castle is too well-defended!|Holowan, to Jango Fett and Zam Wesell|<ref name="SWA6:TWOB" />}}
Hurlo Holowan, a [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] with an aristocratic heritage, was cunning, intelligent, and very wealthy.<ref name="SWA6:TWOB" /> She had short dark hair and extremely pale skin (she rarely exposed herself to sunlight) and, despite her privileged background, characteristically wore a drab, gray uniform.<ref name="SWA3:THP" />
